description: England, 1875. A century after Victor Frankenstein's doomed experiment, his journals have traded hands for decades. Frankenstein's secrets did not die with him.

title: Free Zone
description: Two women embark on a road trip after they are brought together by circumstance. Rebecca (Portman) flees her hotel after a fight with her mother-in-law (Maura) and hails a taxi driven by Hanna (Lazlo).

title: Holiday Twist
description: Tender thought provoking story of overcoming adversity through intertwining lives that ultimately ends on a magical journey to save Christmas and each other.

title: I'll Be Home for Christmas
description: Due to a sudden blizzard, a group of Christmas shoppers and employees - old flings Drew and Michelle included - are stranded in their local big box store.

title: I'm Not Ready for Christmas
description: Holly's world is turned upside down when her niece's wish to Santa Claus comes true and she cannot tell a lie. As her career and love life go into disarray, she must learn to judge between the truth and what is right.

title: Iron Cross
description: Captain Muller struggles to survive fighting overwhelming Russian forces. Wounded, he is sent to Normandy as our Americans Lee and Trey are preparing for D-day. Soon score is settled and battle brings our GIs and Germans on the same path.

title: Jane
description: Olivia is a young woman who gets deferred from her dream college and experiences frightening panic attacks. In an attempt to regain some sense of control, she embarks on a social media-fuelled rampage against those that stand in her way.

title: Justin Bieber: Our World
description: Viewers go backstage and into the private world of the global superstar as he prepares for his NYE 2020 concert. Bieber delivers an electrifying show on the roof of the Beverly Hilton Hotel for 240 guests - and millions watching via livestream.

title: Last Sentinel
description: Set in the future on a war-ravaged Earth, four soldiers man Sentinel – a remote military base in a vast ocean that separates two warring continents. They await the relief or the enemy, whichever comes first.

title: Million Dollar Baby
description: In the wake of a painful estrangement from his daughter, boxing trainer Frankie Dunn has been unwilling to let himself get close to anyone for a very long time – then Maggie Fitzgerald walks into his gym.

title: Mr. Magorium's Wonder Emporium
description: Mr. Magorium's Wonder Emporium is the most fantastic toy shop in the world. But when Mr. Magorium announces that he will be handing over his shop to Molly Mahoney, the shop decides to throw an unusual tantrum and all the once sparkling, colourful toys turn grey and quiet...

title: My Christmas Inn
description: When business woman Jennifer is informed her parents are will be away for the holidays without her, she decides to leave her busy city life in San Francisco to visit her Grandma’s Inn in Alaska that was left for her in order to fix-up and sell.

title: No Man Of God
description: Bill Hagmaier, an agent in the FBI's Behavioural Analysis Unit, is assigned to probe the dangerous mind of convicted serial killer Ted Bundy prior to his execution.

title: One Night In Miami…
description: This powerful film is a fictional account of one incredible night where American icons Muhammad Ali (Eli Goree), Malcolm X (Kingsley Ben-Adir), Sam Cooke (Leslie Odom Jr.), and Jim Brown (Aldis Hodge) gathered, discussing their roles in the civil rights movement and cultural upheaval of the 1960s.

title: One Night in Millstreet
description: Relive the unforgettable 90's prizefight that saw Steve Collins dethrone Chris Eubank, in a moment that would change boxing forever.

title: Paradise Hills
description: A young woman named Uma (Emma Roberts) wakes one morning in Paradise Hills, where well-off families send their daughters to become the perfect version of themselves. But behind all this "perfection" lies a sinister secret. Milla Jovovich also stars.

title: Potter's Ground
description: A former Confederate marauder tries to make a clean start on a Texas dirt farm, but quickly learns that sometimes the past just won't stay buried.

title: Resurrection Road
description: Led by ex-slave Barabbas, six Black soldiers risk all to destroy a Confederate fort's guns and change the war's fate in a daring mission.

title: Sharing Christmas
description: When the future of her old-fashioned Christmas shop is threatened by an ambitious real estate developer, a determined tenant must find a way to convince him that her beloved shop is worth saving.

title: She's The Man
description: Viola (Amanda Bynes), disguised as her twin brother, joins the high school boys' soccer team and helps win the big game while unexpectedly falling for Duke (Channing Tatum) the hot star forward.

title: The Eastern Front - Point of No Return
description: Russian prisoners are being escorted to a Stalag prison camp, by a group of German soldiers. Their life stories unfold and when the Russians escape and are fighting for their lives behind enemy lines, some of their captors start to question if they’re on the right side.

title: The Experiment
description: A remake of the powerful German thriller Das Experiment, in which 26 men are chosen to act the roles of guards and prisoners in a psychological study.

title: The Killing (Forbrydelsen)
description: Emmy-Award nominated crime thriller spanning the course of a 20-day murder investigation.

title: The Last Boy on Earth
description: In a distant future, an enigmatic boy becomes the central figure in the search for a new hope.

title: The Last Son
description: Isaac LeMay (Sam Worthington) is a murderous outlaw cursed by a terrible prophecy, hunting down his offspring to prevent his own murder before targeting his son Cal (Colson Baker). With bounty hunters and the enigmatic U.S. officer Solomon (Jane) on their tail, all are set on a collision course.

title: The Song of Names
description: Martin Simmonds has been haunted throughout his life by the mysterious disappearance of his "brother" and extraordinary best friend, a Polish Jewish virtuoso  violinist, Dovidl Rapaport, who vanished shortly before his 1951 London debut concert.

title: The Street
description: As the glinting steel and mirror-glass skyscrapers of London's financial hub edge ever closer, the area surrounding Hoxton Street has been transformed by 'luxury' redevelopments and sky-high property prices.

title: The Tender Bar
description: ​​From director George Clooney and based on the best-selling memoir, The Tender Bar follows an aspiring writer (Tye Sheridan) pursuing his romantic and professional dreams. From a stool in his uncle’s (Ben Affleck) bar, he learns what it means to grow up from a colorful group of local characters.

title: Tosh
description: This is the definitive portrait of John Toshack; Welsh, Liverpool and Swansea legend, and one of football's most inspirational figures.

title: Underworld
description: For centuries, two races have evolved. Hidden deeply within human culture – the aristocratic, sophisticated Vampires, and the brutal, feral Lycans (werewolves). To humanity, their existence is no more than a whisper of a myth.

title: Underworld Evolution
description: As the feud between vampires and werewolves escalates to new heights, so too does Underworld Evolution, delivering a veritable feast of bloodthirsty power, forbidden love and sweeping vengeance.

title: Underworld Rise of the Lycans
description: The prequel story traces the origins of the centuries-old blood feud between the aristocratic vampires known as Death Dealers and their onetime slaves, the Lycans.

title: Vanishing on 7th Street
description: When a power outage plunges the city of Detroit into darkness, a disparate group of individuals find themselves alone. The city’s population has vanished into thin air, leaving behind heaps of empty clothing, abandoned cars and lengthening shadows.

title: War Blade
description: Banks, an agent of the British SOE, is tasked with rescuing a French resistance fighter from a hidden Nazi bunker. With the help of a German Nurse and a ragtag group of allies, Banks must journey to the belly of the beast.

title: We Go in at Dawn
description: Six days before D-Day, Victor Lawrence, one of the most senior planners of the Normandy landings, is shot down over France. Captured by the Nazis, he is detained in a holding camp under a false identity.

title: What Goes Up
description: Set in the mid-80's when a reporter is sent to cover the Challenger Space Shuttle launch only to become mixed up in the lives of some local students.

title: What We Find On The Road
description: Estranged dad challenges TJ with a vintage car on his 18th birthday, urging a cross-country road trip. With eccentric companions, TJ embarks on a humorous, resilient journey, realizing life's longest roads can lead home.

title: Wicked: The Real Story
description: Delve into the mesmerising journey of the renowned stage production 'Wicked' in this captivating documentary. Uncover the rich history behind the beloved book and stage adaptation, tracing its path to critical acclaim in the UK and beyond.

title: WWII: The Long Road Home
description: 16 year old aspiring director Elliott Hasler's epic depiction of his great-grandfather's WW2 experiences; an escaped POW's battle for survival whilst on the run in war-torn Italy, as his wife and young son eagerly await news in England.
